title: Formulae & Substitution

problems_fixed.what: Mis-posed 'find k' meta-question whose only misconception was the pipeline arguing with itself (with an em dash). Replaced with a well-posed substitution on the SAME formula that yields a clean integer.
problems_fixed.old: Rearrange v^2=u^2+2as for s. The answer is s=(v^2-u^2)/k. Find k.  (solutions [2])
problems_fixed.new: If v^2=u^2+2as, find s when v=10, u=4, a=6.  (solutions [7]; 100=16+12s -> s=7)

problems_fixed.what: 'find a' coefficient meta-question that cannot support numeric guided steps. Replaced with a numeric solve on the SAME formula (subject appears twice), clean integer.
problems_fixed.old: Make x the subject: y=(x+3)/(x-1). Numerator of the answer is y+a. Find a.  (solutions [3])
problems_fixed.new: If y=(x+3)/(x-1), find x when y=3.  (solutions [3]; 3(x-1)=x+3 -> x=3)

opener_concept: Taxi fare: £3 to get in, then £2 per mile. Students compute a 4-mile (£11) and 6-mile (£15) fare by common sense, which IS substituting into C = 3 + 2m; the reveal names that as substitution.
